names.note: The name given in some Latin recensions before his baptism.

death.note: The passions place his martyrdom under Decius. There is no independent evidence for the date, or for the person.

source.note: His feast was removed from the General Roman Calendar in the 1969 revision, on the grounds that little is historically established about him beyond the fact of an early cult. He remains in the Martyrology and his veneration was never withdrawn, so this is recorded as 'venerated'. Removal from a calendar and a finding of non-veneration are different things, and collapsing them here would misrepresent both.

source.text: The Prologue of Ohrid, Nikolai Velimirović
